description: Agent-based, multiplex network diffusion model of mask-wearing adoption with two-stage dynamics (information reception then behavior), complex contagion, policy and media effects, churn, and dynamic homophily-driven rewiring. Trained on days 0–29 and used to predict days 30–39.

parameters.seed_selection: Use observed wearing_mask at earliest day as adopters; observed received_info as informed

behaviors.name: observe_neighbors
behaviors.description: Compute weighted neighbor adoption exposure per layer and overall (with overlap boost), possibly aggregated over a window.
behaviors.algorithm: For each person i: for each layer L, compute frac_L = weighted fraction adopting among neighbors encountered (Bernoulli contact per neighbor with prob p_L). Combine layers: frac_all = sum_L (w_L * frac_L) / sum_L (w_L). Apply overlap multiplier to dyads appearing in multiple layers when sampling exposures. Optionally average frac_all over past W days.

behaviors.name: update_belief
behaviors.description: Update informed state based on base hazard, neighbor influences, exogenous media, and policy messaging.
behaviors.algorithm: For non-informed i: compute p_info = 1 - (1 - info_hazard_base) * (1 - info_external_rate * media_reach * messaging_intensity * message_credibility) * product over adopting neighbors encountered of (1 - info_peer_effect). Draw Bernoulli(p_info) to set informed=true.

behaviors.name: decide_adopt
behaviors.description: Adoption decision using logistic hazard with complex contagion (quadratic term), info term, risk term, layer-specific effects, policy odds multiplier, and optional delay.
behaviors.algorithm: If already adopting => skip. If i is in stubborn subset => adoption only via mandate odds multiplier; otherwise: compute features: x = frac_all, x2 = x^2, info = 1 if informed, risk = risk_perception, layer terms (frac per layer). logit = alpha + b1*x + b2*x2 + gI*info + gR*risk + gXR*risk*x + gF*frac_family + gW*frac_work + gC*frac_comm. If mandate active, add log(policy_odds_multiplier) to logit. Adjust for utility difference: U = benefit_perceived - compliance_cost; add U to logit. p = sigmoid(logit). If adoption_function == 'threshold': maintain cumulative weighted exposures E_i; adopt when E_i >= K_i ~ Poisson(lambda). If logistic: draw Bernoulli(p) to create a pending adoption with delay d ~ LogNormal(mu_log, sigma_log); activate after d days if not dropped before.

behaviors.name: drop_mask
behaviors.description: Churn hazard increases when local adoption is low, with fatigue and risk moderation; minimum duration enforcement.
behaviors.algorithm: For adopters with time_since_adoption >= min_duration: compute n = frac_all; logit_drop = intercept + bN*(1 - n) + bR*(1 - risk) + f*(fatigue_rate * time_since_adoption). p_drop = min(cap, sigmoid(logit_drop) + dropout_base_rate). Draw Bernoulli(p_drop) to drop.

behaviors.name: rewire_social_ties
behaviors.description: Dynamic homophily-driven rewiring favoring same adoption status and same group ties.
behaviors.algorithm: With prob dynamic_rewire_prob per ego: pick a random edge (i,j). If adoption status differs and homophily_strength > 0, consider rewiring: sample k not connected to i with probability proportional to homophily (same adoption, same age_group/occupation) and swap edge (i,j)->(i,k) preserving degree.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Weighted neighbor adoption exposure drives a logistic or threshold adoption decision.
interactions.effect: Increases adoption hazard; multiple exposures produce complex contagion.

interactions.name: social_reinforcement
interactions.description: Repeated exposures across layers produce supra-linear increase in adoption hazard.
interactions.effect: Quadratic term and overlap multiplier raise hazard.

interactions.name: information_broadcast
interactions.description: Media and public health messages increase rate of becoming informed.
interactions.effect: Raises info hazard; shortens adoption latency indirectly.

interactions.name: policy_mandate_enforcement
interactions.description: Mandate increases odds of adoption and reduces dropout via perceived penalties and norms.
interactions.effect: Multiplies odds of adoption; lowers effective compliance cost; reduces drop probability.

interactions.name: tie_rewiring_homophily
interactions.description: Network edges rewire to increase homophily, affecting diffusion pathways.
interactions.effect: Increases assortativity by adoption and by groups.

interactions.name: location_based_contact
interactions.description: Layer-specific contact probabilities modulate daily exposure opportunities.
interactions.effect: Scales effective exposure counts per layer.

modules.name: SocialNetworkEngine
modules.description: Maintains multiplex network, computes contact events and exposures, and performs homophily-based rewiring.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each agent i:
  sample contacts per layer L by Bernoulli(p_contact_L) over i's neighbors in L
  compute frac_L(i) = (#contacts adopting in L) / (max(1, #contacts in L))
  if dyad (i,j) exists in multiple layers, multiply contribution by multiplex_overlap_multiplier
  frac_overall(i) = sum_L layer_weight_L * frac_L(i) / sum_L layer_weight_L
with probability dynamic_rewire_prob per ego i:
  select random neighbor j; if adoption_state[i] != adoption_state[j]:
    propose k not in neighbors(i) with probability proportional to homophily(adoption, age_group, occupation)
    rewire (i,j)->(i,k) if proposal accepted
emit signal.frac_neighbors_by_layer, signal.frac_neighbors_overall and exposures_by_layer
notes: Symmetrize edges once at init; maintain layer-specific adjacency.

modules.calibration_notes: Tune layer weights, contact probs, and overlap multiplier to match early Rb and exposure-to-adoption statistics.

modules.name: PolicyAndMessaging
modules.description: Activates mandates and broadcasts public health messages via media channels.

update_rule.pseudocode:
policy_active = (current_day >= mandate_start_day)
policy_odds_multiplier = policy_active ? policy_odds_multiplier : 1.0
messaging_intensity_effective = messaging_intensity * media_reach * message_credibility * (1 + 0.1*message_bias)
emit signals
notes: Penalty and enforcement are implicitly captured in policy_odds_multiplier and also reduce drop hazard.
campaign_start_day aligns messaging onset with mandate by default.

modules.calibration_notes: policy_odds_multiplier and messaging_intensity constrained by pre/post trends around day 10 (DiD).

modules.name: InfoDiffusion
modules.description: Updates each agent's informed state based on base hazard, peer adoption, and messaging signals.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each non-informed agent i:
  peer_term = 1 - (1 - info_peer_effect_per_adopting_neighbor)^(expected_contacts_adopting)
  msg_term = info_external_rate * messaging_intensity_effective
  p_info = 1 - (1 - info_hazard_base) * (1 - peer_term) * (1 - msg_term)
  if rand() < p_info: informed[i] = True
emit signal.informed_flags
notes: expected_contacts_adopting approximated from frac_overall and degree/contact rates.
Observation noise can flip informed with low probability if needed.

modules.calibration_notes: Fit hazards on received_info transitions; constrain by observed info before adoption.

modules.name: SocialInfluenceAdoption
modules.description: Computes adoption hazards and executes adoption with optional delay, incorporating info, peers, risk, layers, and policy.

notes: Stubborn agents can still adopt under strong mandate via odds multiplier acting on utility; to model hard stubbornness, skip adoption unless policy_active is true.
Initial adopters fixed from day 0 data.

modules.calibration_notes: Calibrate logistic coefficients via discrete-time hazard fit; refine with simulation-based objective including churn and Rb.

modules.name: DropoutAndFatigue
modules.description: Models churn among adopters driven by low local adoption, low risk, and fatigue; enforces a minimum duration.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each adopting agent i with time_since_adoption >= dropout_min_duration_days:
  n = frac_overall[i]
  logit_drop = drop_logit_intercept + drop_beta_one_minus_neighbor_frac*(1 - n) + drop_beta_one_minus_risk*(1 - risk_perception[i]) + fatigue_rate * time_since_adoption
  if policy_active: logit_drop -= log(1 + mandate_enforcement_strength)
  p_drop = min(dropout_probability_cap, sigmoid(logit_drop) + dropout_base_rate)
  drop_now = (rand() < p_drop)
  if drop_now: set adoption_state=false; reset time_since_adoption
emit signal.dropout_flags
notes: Policy reduces drop hazard to capture enforcement and norm effects.
Churn is attenuated by high neighbor adoption via (1 - n) term.

modules.calibration_notes: Fit to observed reversions and survival of adoption durations.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates daily observables and computes evaluation metrics inputs.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate_daily[t] = mean_i(adoption_state[i])
by_group = groupby(age_group).mean(adoption_state)
final_adoption_rate = adoption_rate_daily[last]
time_to_50 = first t with adoption_rate_daily[t] >= 0.5
Rb_series[t] = (new_adopters_in_window[t]) / (active_adopters[t-1]) over window Rb_window
churn_rate_daily[t] = (#drops at t) / (#adopters at t-1)
mean_exposures_before_adoption = average exposures counted for adopting agents
assortativity_by_adoption = Newman assortativity over current adoption states
inequality_of_adoption = difference or Gini across groups specified by inequality_group_field
policy_effect_size = slope_post - slope_pre around mandate_start_day
info_rate_daily[t] = mean_i(informed[i])
peak_adoption_rate = max_t adoption_rate_daily[t]
emit all observables
notes: Rb computed over a sliding window (default 3 days) for early-phase comparability.
Inequality_by_adoption uses age_group by default; configurable.

modules.calibration_notes: Not calibrated; used as target signals for other modules.

procedures: Load agent_attributes.csv; cast agent_id to int; map age_group, occupation.
Load social_network.json; convert keys to int; deduplicate and symmetrize per layer; compute degree per layer and overall.
Load train_data.csv; parse booleans; extract earliest day as day 0; set adoption_state and informed from day 0.
If any agents missing day 0 in train_data, impute using initial_adoption_rate and initial_informed_rate by risk_perception strata.
Construct stubborn set by sampling stubborn_fraction of agents with probability inversely proportional to risk_perception.
Precompute multiplex overlap indicators and initial assortativity.

algorithms.Discrete-time hazard adoption: Logistic regression with nonlinearity and interactions; optional mandate-induced odds multiplier; delayed activation via lognormal.
algorithms.Complex contagion threshold: Cumulative weighted exposures vs Poisson threshold K_i ~ Poisson(adoption_threshold_lambda).
algorithms.Info diffusion hazard: Competing hazards: base + peer + exogenous messaging.
algorithms.Drop hazard: Logistic drop hazard combining low local adoption, low risk, and fatigue; capped probability; policy reduces hazard.
algorithms.Homophily rewiring: Edge replacement biased toward same adoption and group; preserves degree.
algorithms.Rb estimation: Windowed ratio of new adopters to active adopters lagged by one step.
